description: Terms of service, terms of use, or privacy policy

clauses.name: User Obligations and Acceptable Use
clauses.description: What users must do or refrain from doing

high: Extremely broad prohibited activities
Account can be terminated for vague violations
medium: Broad but reasonable restrictions on use

clauses.name: Data Collection and Use
clauses.description: What personal data is collected and how it is used

high: Collects data beyond what's needed for the service
Data sold to third parties
No opt-out for data collection
medium: Broad data collection with some opt-out options
low: Minimal data collection with clear purpose and user control

clauses.name: Limitation of Liability
clauses.description: Caps or exclusions on the provider's liability

high: Complete exclusion of all liability including gross negligence
No liability for data loss or breaches
medium: Standard liability cap at fees paid
low: Reasonable liability provisions with exceptions for willful misconduct

clauses.name: Indemnification
clauses.description: User's obligation to indemnify the provider

high: Broad indemnification for any claim related to user's use
No cap on indemnification
User must indemnify for provider's own negligence
medium: Standard indemnification for user content and violations
low: Narrow, reasonable indemnification limited to user's breach

clauses.name: Termination of Service
clauses.description: How the provider can terminate or suspend the service/account

high: Provider can terminate at any time for any reason without notice
No refund of prepaid fees on termination
No data export on termination
medium: Provider can terminate with notice but limited appeal process
low: Clear termination process with notice, data export, and proportional refund

clauses.name: Changes to Terms
clauses.description: How the provider can modify the terms of service

high: Terms can change at any time with no notice
Continued use equals acceptance of any change
medium: Changes with notice but no opt-out except termination
low: Material changes require active consent or reasonable notice period with opt-out

clauses.name: Dispute Resolution
clauses.description: How disputes between user and provider are handled

high: Mandatory binding arbitration with class action waiver
User pays all dispute costs
Forum in distant jurisdiction
medium: Mandatory arbitration but with cost-sharing provisions
low: User retains right to small claims court, reasonable dispute process

clauses.name: Intellectual Property Rights
clauses.description: Ownership rights over user content and platform IP

high: Provider takes ownership of all user content
Irrevocable worldwide license to user content with no restriction
medium: Broad license to user content for service operation
low: User retains ownership, provider gets limited license for service delivery

clauses.name: Governing Law
clauses.description: Which jurisdiction's laws govern the terms

high: Governing law in a jurisdiction with weak consumer protections
low: Governing law in user's jurisdiction or internationally recognized neutral forum
